articles.title: Nationwide power failure hits Caribbean island as American citizens warned to prepare - Fox News
articles.description: Cuba's sixth nationwide power grid collapse of 2026 leaves residents in sweltering heat as the U.S. Embassy in Havana is warning American travelers headed there.
articles.content:
Americans who are legally traveling to Cuba should expect major disruptions because of the country's blackout crisis, according to officials.
